verified.exploit_entry_point: Express controller request handlers (the handlers the product's routers register) that take a caller-supplied credential id, load the stored Credential, decrypt it, and use its OpenAI key. Driven by invoking each controller's default-export handler directly with fabricated req/res/next; the service/controller product code runs unchanged. Only the infrastructure boundary is stubbed (an in-memory repository with TypeORM finder/query-builder parity via getRunningExpressApp, decryptCredentialData, the OpenAI SDK), exactly as the project's own unit tests virtual-mock typeorm and the repository. The instruction states that the check must live in the operation's own handler so a handler-level fix is exactly what the suite exercises.
variants: base (published fix): the vector-store module looks the credential up by id alone across its 7 routes; the fix scopes it to the caller's workspace via resolveCredentialForWorkspace (direct ownership or an explicit WorkspaceShared share)
uncovered route (real upstream): the assistants module (list assistants / read single assistant via ?credential=) does the same unscoped lookup and is NOT touched by this advisory's fix
injected sibling S1: an added model-listing helper (?credential=) that decrypts and uses the key though it only returns model ids
injected sibling S2: an added credential-verification helper (credential id in the request body) that decrypts and uses the key though it returns only a status
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own jest unit tests do not cover the affected modules at the pinned commit (no openai-assistants*, oauth2, or tenantRequestGuards tests exist; the fix adds only tenantRequestGuards.test.ts). The hidden suites run offline against the pinned+injected source and pass on the oracle; security 17 fail on pinned+injected and 17 pass on the oracle; functional 6 pass on both.

wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the flaw is a one-way cross-tenant read/use of a credential; there are no roles, peers, or directions to fix only one of
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the guard compares the credential's owning workspace to the caller's active workspace directly; no attacker-controlled value is normalized or adjusted before the check

notes: Injected track. inject.patch (in environment/) adds the two sibling helpers (listAssistantModels, verifyAssistantCredential) to our copy only; applied at image build after checkout. Oracle = published vector-store + oauth2 + tenantRequestGuards changes, plus workspace-scoping of the assistants module (uncovered route) and both injected siblings. The published fix also scopes oauth2 /authorize (path-param shape, separate router); it is included in the oracle for fidelity but not exercised by the hidden suite (its handler is an inline router callback, not a controller export; recorded in out_of_scope).
